text: modelspoke 是面向 DSH Web 的本地模型提供方插件，可在设置卡片中添加兼容模型服务，并通过 DSH 的模型适配器接入。它自动读取服务器模型目录，识别 Ollama、llama.cpp、LM Studio、vLLM 与 SGLang 等服务的能力信息，再按用户覆盖、服务发现、内置预设和默认值逐字段解析模型配置。你可以管理提供方和模型列表，设置上下文与输出上限、图像输入及推理等级。适合在 DSH 中使用自托管或本地模型；服务地址由用户配置，认证密钥可从环境变量读取。

modelspoke connects local model servers to DSH Web, discovers models and capabilities, and resolves settings from overrides, server metadata, presets, or defaults. Configure model lists, context, image input, and reasoning levels. Use a server URL and optional environment key.
想在 DSH 里连接自己电脑上的本地模型服务。
帮我自动读取兼容模型服务器提供的模型列表和能力。
我想给本地模型配置上下文长度、图像输入和推理等级。
让 DSH 根据服务发现结果和我的覆盖设置解析模型参数。
Connect a self-hosted OpenAI-compatible model server to DSH.
Discover model capabilities and reasoning settings from my local provider.
modelspoke 的功能「Provider setup」：通过 Web 设置卡片添加、编辑和删除提供方，填写服务地址及可选的密钥环境变量，并查看模型目录获取状态。。
modelspoke 的功能「Model discovery」：插件请求兼容服务的 /v1/models 目录，并通过 Ollama、llama.cpp、LM Studio、vLLM、SGLang 后端补充可识别的模型能力。。
modelspoke 的功能「Model metadata resolution」：对每个模型逐字段优先采用用户覆盖、服务发现、内置预设或默认值，并记录各字段来源；可配置推理等级、上下文与图像输入。。
modelspoke 使用路由配置的 baseURL 请求模型服务器；若设置 apiKeyEnv，会从对应环境变量读取密钥并在非空时以 Bearer 认证发送。

modelspoke README · modelspoke：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A plugin for DeepSeek Harness for managing connections to local, OpenAI-compatible model servers.
It is an improved replacement for the stock dsh custom provider setup: it discovers your servers and
models instead of requiring hand-written provider blocks and per-model fields, and provides the
capabilities the stock setup lacks.

modelspoke README · Features：**First-class llama-swap and Ollama support**

The router llama-swap is highly recommended for local model hoarders since it can serve as a source of truth for model capabilities across harnesses. modelspoke understands the capability data that llama-swap adds to its extended OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Capability discovery also supports Ollama's API extensions.

**Presets for common models**

modelspoke README · Features：To help out with endpoints that don't have full capability discovery (e.g. llama-server, vLLM, sglang) modelspoke includes a table of capabilities for common base models to use in initial configuration.

**Full-featured setup UI**

Setup is easy to use and covers all the day-to-day fields (the deep template-contract fields — `compat` — stay hand-edited in the file). Allows for overriding presets and discovered capabilities and maintaining multiple setting profiles of the same underlying model.

modelspoke README · Features：**Reasoning effort levels**

dsh custom provider functionality doesn't afford any way to set reasoning effort. Modelspoke can discover the supported effort levels and allows customizing the map from the UI effort setting to the model supported setting.

**Image input**

modelspoke README · Features：Models with multimodal capabilities are great but if you add them via the dsh custom provider setup that functionality is not available. Modelspoke can discover image input capability or allow you to specify it. dsh 0.1.5 renders the `read_image` tool's inline results in session chat natively — modelspoke's role is surfacing which models accept images at all.

modelspoke README · Installation & setup：Prerequisite: dsh **0.1.7** (verified against 0.1.7-rc.1) with the
`dsh plugin` command.

1. **Install:** dsh installs plugins with a tool called pnpm. If you don't
   have it yet, install it first:

```console
   npm install --global pnpm
   ```

Then one command for each profile where you will use local models:

```console
   dsh plugin --profile web add modelspoke
   dsh plugin --profile headless add modelspoke
   ```

2. **Restart dsh if it is running**, so it picks up the plugin.

modelspoke README · Installation & setup：3. **Open the Modelspoke settings card.** In the dsh web UI, select
   **Plugins** in the left sidebar, open the **modelspoke** row in the
   Installed group — the Modelspoke card renders on its bundle detail
   page, then **+ Add provider**:

modelspoke README · Installation & setup：4. **Point it at your server.** Set the provider's name, its base URL, the
   *environment variable name* holding the API key (omit for keyless local
   servers — no auth header is sent in that case), and an optional default
   effort (`minimal` … `max`) — then commit with the card's **Apply**
   button. The row's status dot goes green once the model fetch succeeds.

modelspoke README · Installation & setup：5. **Configure per model where you want to.** Expanding a provider fetches
   its model list; each model row has a chevron that opens an editable
   detail (context window, max output tokens, the thinking-level map,
   nothink, image input, reasoning effort):

The model list is the curation — a model is addressable by the agent
   only while it is in the list; clearing a detail field releases that
   field back down the resolution chain.
